notes.title: Game Resetting-New City System
notes.content:
Note: The game is still being reset and the current version does not match the announcement. I apologize for this and there is no need for you to download the current game.
The original city is like speckled decorations, without much sense of participation or any distinctive features.

notes.title: SanGuo 223 Reset No.1
notes.content:
Through various feedbacks, it can be seen that the Three Kingdoms 223 is an unfinished work and not an interesting failure. This is my major dereliction of duty, it is a failed work that ignores the feelings of various players.
The boring gameplay, complex mechanisms, and unsatisfactory copywriting make it imperative to redo the Three Kingdoms 223, otherwise it will waste the time and money of all players.
The Three Kingdoms 223 is being remade, and the newly released terrain map, which is currently being processed, has richer graphics and colors compared to the original version. In order to express geographical characteristics, the terrain is also greatly exaggerated.
These pictures show the landscape of the new version of terrain.

notes.title: 游戏单位选中优化
notes.content: 点击屏幕右上角的军事单位的展示图，也可以实现军事单位的选中。这样在两个军事单位重合后，也可以进行分别选中。

notes.title: 游戏简单优化
notes.content:
增加围城提示，文本优化；
娱乐面板开放魔幻宫廷。

notes.title: Game Adds Simple Mode,
notes.content: The game adds simple mode, completing the upgrade of all city buildings at the beginning of the game, without the need for players to manage cities and worry about the economy and manpower.

notes.title: Reduce difficulty
notes.content:
1. Add opening guidance and strategy

2. Simplify the entertainment panel

1) Reduce Army Expenditures

2) Increase the experience gained from winning battles

notes.title: Simplify Game
notes.content:
1. Accelerate the movement of the start interface UI

2. Simplify the 12 state governors in the economic panel to 6 governors

3. Simplify the 16 military generals in the military panel to 4 senior generals

4. Cancel the setting of city guards

notes.title: Add Tutorial in Game
notes.content: The initial version of the game did not have any tutorials, which caused inconvenience to all players. I apologize for this and add tutorials to this game.
